articles.title: ADC Guber Candidate Constitutes Campaign Council In Kano
articles.summary: The African Democratic Congress(ADC) governorship candidate in Kano State, Ibrahim Ali Amin, popularly known as Little, has constituted an 18-member campaign council ahead of the 2027 general elections. According to a statement issued by the candidate’s Director of Media and Strategic Communication, Adnan Mukhtar, the council, is expected to coordinate and oversee the party’s campaign
articles.hausa_translation: Sabon ADC Kandidin Kudin Guber a Kano Ya Kafa Majalisar Kamfen. Kandidin ADC na gwamnantacciyar kura a Jihar Kano, Ibrahim Ali Amin, wanda aka kira Little, ya kafa majalis kamfen mai membobi 18 a gida kafin zaben shekarar 2027. A cewar sanarwar da Direktan Jarida da Dabarun Manufactura na kandidin, Adnan Mukhtar, ana tsammanin majalisar za ta gudanar da jerin kamfen na jam'iyyar.
critical_questions: Who are the 18 council members and do they represent genuine grassroots support or elite patronage networks?
What is the financial backing for this campaign and where is the funding coming from?
Why is an ADC candidate receiving significant media coverage when major parties (APC, PDP) dominate Kano politics?
What is the track record of Ibrahim Ali Amin and what specific policy platform differentiates ADC from competitors?
Is this campaign council announcement substantive political organization or premature positioning ahead of 2027 when other crises demand attention?

articles.title: Why I Endorsed Tinubu, APC, Islamic Cleric Explains
articles.summary: A Jalingo-based Islamic scholar, Dr Ibrahim Jalo Muhammad Jalingo, has justified his support for the All Progressives Congress (APC) in the forthcoming elections, citing national unity, political stability and the need to sustain power rotation between Nigeria’s North and South. The cleric said allowing the South to complete its eight-year presidential tenure under President Bola […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jalingo jiya, masanin ilmin addini mai suna Dr Ibrahim Jalo Muhammad Jalingo ya bayyana dalilansu na goyon bayan APC a zaben da ke zuwa, ya yi nuni ga fahimtar jama'a, tsayuwar mulki da bukatar juyuwa mulki tsakanin arewacin Najeriya da kudu. Mai ibada ya ce barin Kudu ya kammala shekaru takwas na mulkin Shugaba Bola...
critical_questions: What material or political benefits has Dr. Jalo Muhammad Jalingo received from the APC that might motivate this endorsement?
Why is an Islamic cleric's individual endorsement being amplified by Leadership newspaper, and who funded or facilitated this coverage?
The claim about 'power rotation' as justification - is there documented evidence the APC and Tinubu have committed to this principle, or is this assumption?
What are the competing voices from other Islamic scholars in Taraba state, and why are they absent from this narrative?
Does the article provide any substantive policy positions Tinubu/APC will implement, or does it rely solely on abstract principles like 'stability' and 'unity'?

articles.title: I Have No Interest In Becoming Eze-Uzu Awka — Ex-AA Guber Candidate
articles.summary: The candidate of the Action Alliance (AA) in the November 8, 2025 Anambra State governorship election, Ozo Jeff Nweke, has dismissed the rumour that he is positioning himself for the traditional stool of his Awka community, otherwise known as “Eze -Uzu Awka” Reacting to the rumour making the rounds in the community that the […]
articles.hausa_translation: Tsohon majigin zaben Action Alliance a Anambra, Ozo Jeff Nweke, ya toshe jita cewa yana shirya kansa don karbar kursi na gida a Awka, wanda ake kira 'Eze-Uzu Awka'. Ya mayar da hankali ga rumowar da ke yaduwa a gida cewa...
critical_questions: Why is this rumor circulating now, and who benefits from associating Nweke with the traditional stool?
What evidence supports or refutes the claim that Nweke is positioning for the Eze-Uzu Awka title, and why is his denial newsworthy?
Are there missing voices - such as statements from the actual Awka traditional council or kingmakers - that would clarify the legitimacy of this rumor?
Is the timing of this story connected to post-election politics or community succession planning, and does Nweke's gubernatorial loss make him more vulnerable to such claims?
What is the source of this rumor, and does the article provide sufficient evidence that it warranted a public denial?

articles.hausa_translation: 2027: APC taron sada ya zama bugi ga Nigerians, Kawu yana gargaɗi shugabannin jam'iyya - Senator Kawu Sumaila Suleiman (APC, Kano South) ya bayar da gargaɗi ga shugabannin APC cewa nuni na arziki, dalilin murna da lilin da ake yi a taron neman jiya na shugaban kasar sai sa ƙarfin bacin rai na jama'a a arewa.

articles.title: NAPTIP records 1,508 trafficking cases, 1,434 arrests

articles.hausa_translation: IGP ya ziyarci Otti, ya yaba wa gwamnatin Abia don goyon bayan da suke ba wa 'yan sanda ta Najeriya. Governon Abia ya ce, 'Na gode da ziyarci IGP kuma ina fita da juyawar hulda mai tsaya da Nigerian Police Force a cikin namu na halin karfi da tsaro a Abia State.'
critical_questions: What specific security challenges or incidents in Abia State prompted this high-level visit, and are they being adequately disclosed?

articles.title: South Africa: 17 killed in 2 mass shootings
articles.summary: No fewer than 17 people were killed in two separate mass shootings across South Africa on Sunday night, police said on Monday. Nine people, comprising six men and three women, were shot dead inside a shack at the Jeffsville informal settlement in Atteridgeville, west of Pretoria. Police said the identities of the suspects and the […]

Mutane 9, da suka hada da maza shida da mata uku, an kashe su a cikin gida mai gida a unguwar Jeffsville mara tsari a Atteridgeville, wajen yamma na Pretoria. articles.title: EU nations’ plan for Rwanda migrant deportation hub
articles.summary: Five EU countries, including Germany and Denmark, unveiled on Monday a plan to establish a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda – the first such facility outside the bloc. The group, which also includes Austria, Greece and the Netherlands, wanted to open a “return hub” after the European Union cleared the way by toughening migration rules. […]

Rukunin da ya kuma haɗa Austria, Girka da Netherlands, suna son buɗe 'cibiyar dawowa' bayan EU ta daidaita ka'idojin ƙaurin bakin haure.
